title: CLCON/69/2017 of JEEVAN REKHA HOSPITAL (A UNIT OF M/S JEEVAN REKHA MEDICAL CARE SERVICES LTD.) Vs Chandresh Kumar

paras.text:
CLCON No. 69 of 2017
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(Via Video Conferencing)
List revised. None appears for the
petitioner.
After the issuance of notices to the
contemnor by the Coordinate Bench of this
Court on 27th March, 2017, the petitioner took
steps and there is an office report that the
District Magistrate, who was occupying the
office at the relevant point of time, who was
supposed to comply the order, has been
transferred and new incumbent has joined in
the Office of District Magistrate.
Since there is no response filed, as such
till date, this contempt petition is adjourned in
order to enable the learned counsel for the
petitioner to file an appropriate impleadment
application.
If the impleadment application is not
filed within a period of three weeks from
today, it would be deemed that the petitioner
is not interest in pursuing the contempt
petition, and the same would be treated to be
dismissed.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 18.12.2020
Shiv
